name: License-image and bank-information lending for fraudulent crowdsourcing registration

attribution.legal_posture: Japanese police reported an apprehension using 検挙; the cited annual report records the apprehension stage, with prosecution, formal charge, conviction, and sentence status unreported.

ttps: Tokyo police reported apprehending two Japanese men for allegedly aiding the unlawful creation and use of private electromagnetic records by providing driver-license image information and bank-account information for fraudulent registration of a crowdsourcing-company account by a person believed to be a DPRK IT worker.
caveats: License image, bank data, account identifier, and personal name are excluded from collection and republication.
The government source reports the enforcement event and describes the associated worker as a person believed to be a DPRK IT worker; identity remains unreported.
